# Introduction

Students on the Open Science course have enjoyed seeing the lichen diversity growing around the Finse Field Station. 
Lichens are classified as Ascomycete fungi, as opposed to most classic "mushroom" shaped fungi which are Basidiomycetes. 
What fungi are recorded in GBIF in the area around Finse?

# Results
```{r}
#| label: load-targets
tar_load_everything()
```

GBIF has `{r} nrow(fungi_raw)` fungal records in the Finse region. Of these, `{r} nrow(fungi_clean)` have precision ≤1000km. Most of these records are Ascomycetes, reflecting the high lichen diversity of the area (@fig-bar). Community science data is more common than fungarium data.

```{r} 
#| label: fig-bar
#| fig-cap: Comparison of basis of record for Ascomycota and Basidiomycota in Finse, Norway.


tar_read(figure1)
```
